articles.title: Apple Intelligence finally gets a release window for its debut in China
articles.description: Apple will bring its 2024 Apple Intelligence features to China as soon as December if a new rumor is correct. It is expected as a part of the iOS 27.3 release. articles.title: Apple HomeView hands on: So many questions, but I like it

HomeView with the customizable home modular face that be outfitted with different widgets or home accessories Most of you have seen the general rundown on the hardware. It's a 7-inch Liquid Retina display, perched atop a speaker base or mounted to a wall that you can control with your voice or touch. It has Siri AI built-in to operate your smart home, answer questions, find your lost Apple TV 4K Siri Remote, or otherwise control it. There's a built-in camera that can recognize up to six distinct users to load personal information, such as message history or calendars. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: MediaTek's Big AI Plans: 2nm Chips, Agentic AI & Data Centres | Anku Jain at IMC 2026
articles.description: At India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026, we spoke with Anku Jain, Managing Director of MediaTek India, about the future of smartphones, agentic AI and the company's expanding ambitions beyond mobile processors. With the new Dimensity 9600 Pro, MediaTek is focusing on bringing more powerful on-device AI capabilities to smartphones. Jain explains how the 2nm chipset, equipped with dual NPUs, is designed to support agentic AI experiences while improving computing efficiency and battery consumption. We also discuss whether AI-powered wearables and emerging form factors could eventually replace smartphones, why flagship devices have become increasingly important to MediaTek, and what consumers can expect from its upcoming smartphone partnerships. Beyond smartphones, Jain highlights data centres and cloud computing as major growth opportunities for MediaTek, alongside automotive technologies, IoT and smart glasses. As AI continues to reshape the semiconductor industry, how is MediaTek positioning itself for the next phase of computing? articles.title: iOS 27.2 beta 4: Apple Music goes black-and-white, Apple Health redesign pulled
articles.description: While iOS 27.2 beta 4 brought a new look for Apple Music and a reference to a new HomePod setting, it also curiously removed an upcoming Apple Health upgrade. Here's what you need to know. Apple's redesigned Health app is missing from the fourth beta of iOS 27.2. On Tuesday, shortly after unveiling its HomeView and other smart home products, Apple deployed the fourth developer beta of iOS 27.2. The beta software update bears the build number 24B5110a, up from 24B5099f. In a particularly noticeable visual change, iOS 27.2 beta 4 removes all color from the Apple Music icon. Now, it's just a black musical note on a white background, or inverted in dark mode, rather than the white and red look the icon has used since iOS 14. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums
